# Identity

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Identity details: logons and group membership changes. The account that
logged on, or that made a change, is `super::Event::user`.

Appears at: `/identity`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authentication_package` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.1.0 | The authentication package, for example `Kerberos` or `NTLM`. |
| `group` | [`Account`](account.md) | no |  |  | 1.1.0 | The group whose membership changed. |
| `group_scope` | [`GroupScope`](types.md#groupscope) | no |  |  | 1.1.0 | The group's scope. |
| `logon_process` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.1.0 | The logon process. |
| `member` | [`Account`](account.md) | no |  |  | 1.1.0 | The account added to or removed from the group. |
| `status_code` | integer | no |  | at least 0; format `uint32` | 1.1.0 | For a failed logon: the OS status code (an NTSTATUS value). |
| `sub_status_code` | integer | no |  | at least 0; format `uint32` | 1.1.0 | For a failed logon: the more specific OS status code. |
| `workstation` | string | no |  | 1 to 256 characters | 1.1.0 | The name of the workstation the logon came from. |

Unknown fields are rejected.
